# Rehabify Health (Physio Around Me)

> Rehabify Health — physioaroundme.com, also known as "Physio Around Me" — is a Nigerian physiotherapy platform. Patients find and book physiotherapists who have been reviewed and approved by the Rehabify team, for online video sessions or in-person sessions at home or in a clinic, and pay securely through Paystack. Rehabify also provides practice software for physiotherapy clinics, a referral programme and API for doctors, hospitals, HMOs and health platforms, and the MSK Specialist Program for physiotherapists.

Key facts:

- Country: Nigeria. Online video sessions can be booked from anywhere in Nigeria; in-person sessions (home visits or clinic) depend on where the listed physiotherapists are based.
- Typical reasons people book: back or neck pain, knee and joint pain, sports injuries, arthritis, rehabilitation after surgery, and stroke or other neurological rehabilitation.
- Each physiotherapist sets their own session prices (Rehabify's standard rate applies if they have not). The total is shown before payment. Multi-session packages are discounted.
- Joy is Rehabify's WhatsApp assistant (+234 806 152 5811). Patients can message Joy to describe what is wrong and get matched with a physiotherapist. Joy does not diagnose conditions or provide emergency care.
- HMO coverage is not currently accepted. Patients can pay later through MediLoan, financing offered by MyItura (an independent company).
- Contact: support@physioaroundme.com, +234 806 152 5811 (Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm WAT). Partnerships: partners@physioaroundme.com.

## Patients

- [Find a physiotherapist](https://physioaroundme.com/find-a-physio): Search approved physiotherapists by condition, specialty, name or location, compare experience, reviews and session types (online or in-person), and book.
- [Start treatment](https://physioaroundme.com/start-treatment): Answer a few questions (where you are and what needs attention) to be matched with physiotherapists and see a price before booking.
- [Pricing](https://physioaroundme.com/pricing): How session prices are worked out (location, condition complexity and physiotherapist experience) and package savings of up to 15%.
- [Meet Joy](https://physioaroundme.com/meet-joy): Joy, the WhatsApp recovery companion that sends exercise reminders between sessions and keeps the physiotherapist updated.
- [Pay later with MediLoan](https://physioaroundme.com/payment): Apply for physiotherapy financing from MediLoan (MyItura) directly from the booking page.
- [For patients](https://physioaroundme.com/platform/patients): Recovery plans, exercise videos, chat with your physiotherapist and progress tracking.
- [For families](https://physioaroundme.com/platform/family): How family members can follow and support a loved one's rehabilitation.
- [Physio Register](https://physioaroundme.com/physio-register): Public directory of physiotherapists in Nigeria.

## Physiotherapists and clinics

- [For physiotherapists](https://physioaroundme.com/platform/physiotherapists): Treatment plans, patient messaging, documentation and bookings for physiotherapists who join Rehabify.
- [Clinic software](https://physioaroundme.com/platform/clinics): Practice management for physiotherapy clinics: bookings, billing, patient records, staff scheduling and telehealth.
- [MSK Specialist Program](https://physioaroundme.com/learn): Rehabify Learn's 5-week online programme for physiotherapists, with weekly live clinical sessions, case discussions and a final assessment leading to Rehabify Certified MSK Specialist status.

## Partners and developers

- [Partnerships](https://physioaroundme.com/partnerships): Referral partnerships for doctors, hospitals, HMOs, employers, gyms and health platforms.
- [Partner portal](https://partners.physioaroundme.com): Where partners create referral links, track referred patients and manage API keys and webhooks.
- [API documentation](https://docs.physioaroundme.com): Refer patients to licensed physiotherapists across Nigeria and follow each referral to discharge through a REST API, no-code referral links and signed webhooks.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://docs.physioaroundme.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of the partner API.

## Company and policies

- [About Rehabify Health](https://physioaroundme.com/about): Founded by two Ibadan-trained physiotherapists to fix how patients in Nigeria are referred to and find physiotherapy; mission, values and quality standards.
- [Consultation and booking policy](https://physioaroundme.com/consultation-booking-policy): How matching, booking, payment, confirmation, replacements and online consultations work.
- [Payment policy](https://physioaroundme.com/payment-policy): Payments, cancellations and refunds.
- [Terms and conditions](https://physioaroundme.com/terms-and-conditions)
